host_clock_preflight.rule: all five differences have one sign and exceed the largest paired read span

benchmark.timing_boundaries: perf start, RAW start, CUDA start event, one 20-operation graph replay, CUDA end event, host submission timestamp, end-event sync, RAW end, perf end

capture_semantics: 20 ordered complete staged calls, preallocated fixed-address inputs, coefficients, FP32 scratch, and FP16 outputs; no allocation or synchronization inside capture
